column1: # Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Tribute Games' Paris engine (MonoGame 2.22.5.0) on SDK 13, update 1.0.9 (v589824); 88 shaders split (35 pixel, 53 vertex).
# Tested 2026-11-24 on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Android 16, Adreno 750) with the system's own driver: with the online SDK loaded the game boots to its logo screen at 60 fps and
# goes on to its main menu at 40 fps.
# The intro video's context crashes in the game's own code - a null member reference from its Mono lookup - and two cuts in the game's own main (patches.py) turn that into a
# clean failure, so the intro video is skipped and the game carries on.
# DM_ONLINE_SDK=1 lets the host load the game's Epic Online Services NRO (hle_ro.c); without it the game crashes at its start-up (a null online object).
